title: The Two-Dimensional Narrow Escape Problem with Deterministic Initial Condition: Mean Escape Time and Escape location probabilities
summary: This paper presents a rigorous asymptotic analysis of the two-dimensional narrow escape problem for a Brownian particle initiated at a deterministic position x. While we address the mean escape time, the main novelty lies in our derivation of the asymptotic escape distribution. We derive explicit asymptotic formulas that characterize the dependence of the escape behavior on the relative configuration of the starting point and the window centers. These results remain valid as the starting position approaches the boundary windows and include refined error estimates. The formulas are obtained…
